metadata.provenance_policy: Each stream lists channels_measured (read from the source recording) and channels_synthetic (schema placeholders, not measurements). Health curves cite their provenance.

meta.name: Deutz TCD 12.0 V6 - NRTC Transient Bench Cycle
meta.description: Real engine test-bench measurements over the Non-Road Transient Cycle. The engine is HEALTHY throughout: this stream supplies a transient duty cycle, not a fault. The health curve is a CFD-vs-bench model residual, not a degradation label.

meta.name: ZeMA Hydraulic Rig - Annotated Valve & Cooler Degradation
meta.description: Real 2,205-cycle hydraulic test rig. Cycles are sampled across every annotated condition level and ordered healthy->failed, so the valve progression 100 -> 90 -> 80 -> 73 shown here is measured ground truth from profile.txt, not an injected ramp.

meta.name: MetroPT-3 APU - Reported Air Leak #3
meta.description: Real metro-train Air Production Unit telemetry spanning reported air-leak failure #3 (2020-06-05 10:00:00 to 2020-06-07 14:30:00, high_stress). The health curve marks the company-reported failure window; it is not a threshold on any displayed channel.

meta.name: CVRDE Arjun Mk-1A Thar Desert Assault (50C)
meta.description: High-thermal desert offensive with sand filter choking, injector bank-A fouling, HSU nitrogen seal drift and 120mm main gun recoil cycles. Barrel enters the sortie with 1150 EFC of accumulated service life.
